1	import {

14	} from "drizzle-orm/pg-core";

16	// Admin users (owner or staff member with a login). Clients don't log in.
17	export const users = pgTable("users", {
18	  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
19	  email: text("email").notNull().unique(),
20	  passwordHash: text("password_hash").notNull(),
21	  name: text("name").notNull(),
22	  role: text("role", { enum: ["owner", "staff"] }).notNull().default("staff"),
23	  businessId: uuid("business_id").references(() => businesses.id),
24	  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
25	});
26	
27	export const businesses = pgTable("businesses", {
28	  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
29	  slug: text("slug").notNull().unique(),
30	  name: text("name").notNull(),
31	  timezone: text("timezone").notNull().default("Asia/Almaty"),
32	  currency: text("currency").notNull().default("KZT"),
33	  // How long a picked slot is held in Redis before checkout expires
34	  holdTtlSec: integer("hold_ttl_sec").notNull().default(300),
35	  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
36	});
37	
38	// Opening hours per ISO weekday (1 = Monday … 7 = Sunday). No row = closed.
39	export const businessHours = pgTable(
40	  "business_hours",
41	  {
42	    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
43	    businessId: uuid("business_id").notNull().references(() => businesses.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
44	    weekday: smallint("weekday").notNull(), // 1-7 ISO
45	    openTime: time("open_time").notNull(), // local wall time, e.g. 09:00
46	    closeTime: time("close_time").notNull(),
47	  },
48	  (t) => [uniqueIndex("business_hours_unique").on(t.businessId, t.weekday)],
49	);
50	
51	export const staff = pgTable("staff", {
52	  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
53	  businessId: uuid("business_id").notNull().references(() => businesses.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
54	  userId: uuid("user_id").references(() => users.id), // optional login for this master
55	  name: text("name").notNull(),
56	  isActive: boolean("is_active").notNull().default(true),
57	  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
58	});
59	
60	// Personal schedule overriding business hours. No rows = inherits business hours.
61	export const staffHours = pgTable(
62	  "staff_hours",
63	  {
64	    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
65	    staffId: uuid("staff_id").notNull().references(() => staff.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
66	    weekday: smallint("weekday").notNull(), // 1-7 ISO
67	    startTime: time("start_time").notNull(),
68	    endTime: time("end_time").notNull(),
69	  },
70	  (t) => [uniqueIndex("staff_hours_unique").on(t.staffId, t.weekday)],
71	);
72	
73	export const services = pgTable("services", {
74	  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
75	  businessId: uuid("business_id").notNull().references(() => businesses.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
76	  name: text("name").notNull(),
77	  durationMin: integer("duration_min").notNull(),
78	  priceKzt: integer("price_kzt").notNull(),
79	  isActive: boolean("is_active").notNull().default(true),
80	});
81	
82	// Which masters perform which services (M:N)
83	export const staffServices = pgTable(
84	  "staff_services",
85	  {
86	    staffId: uuid("staff_id").notNull().references(() => staff.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
87	    serviceId: uuid("service_id").notNull().references(() => services.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
88	  },
89	  (t) => [primaryKey({ columns: [t.staffId, t.serviceId] })],
90	);
91	
92	export const clients = pgTable(
93	  "clients",
94	  {
95	    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
96	    businessId: uuid("business_id").notNull().references(() => businesses.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
97	    name: text("name").notNull(),
98	    phone: text("phone").notNull(),
99	    email: text("email"),
100	    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
101	  },
102	  (t) => [uniqueIndex("clients_business_phone_unique").on(t.businessId, t.phone)],
103	);
104	
105	export const bookingStatuses = ["confirmed", "completed", "cancelled", "no_show"] as const;
106	export type BookingStatus = (typeof bookingStatuses)[number];
107	
108	export const bookings = pgTable("bookings", {
109	  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
110	  businessId: uuid("business_id").notNull().references(() => businesses.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
111	  staffId: uuid("staff_id").notNull().references(() => staff.id),
112	  serviceId: uuid("service_id").notNull().references(() => services.id),
113	  clientId: uuid("client_id").notNull().references(() => clients.id),
114	  startAt: timestamp("start_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull(),
115	  endAt: timestamp("end_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull(),
116	  status: text("status", { enum: bookingStatuses }).notNull().default("confirmed"),
117	  priceKzt: integer("price_kzt").notNull(), // snapshot of service price at booking time
118	  note: text("note"),
119	  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
120	});
121	
122	export const waitlistStatuses = ["waiting", "offered", "booked", "expired", "cancelled"] as const;
123	
124	/**
125	 * A client who wants a day that is already full. When a booking is cancelled
126	 * the freed slot is offered down this queue, oldest entry first, each offer
127	 * held for a limited time before it moves on.
128	 */
129	export const waitlistEntries = pgTable(
130	  "waitlist_entries",
131	  {
132	    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
133	    businessId: uuid("business_id").notNull().references(() => businesses.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
134	    serviceId: uuid("service_id").notNull().references(() => services.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
135	    // null = any master who performs the service
136	    staffId: uuid("staff_id").references(() => staff.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
137	    clientId: uuid("client_id").notNull().references(() => clients.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
138	    dateISO: text("date_iso").notNull(), // local date at the business, YYYY-MM-DD
139	    status: text("status", { enum: waitlistStatuses }).notNull().default("waiting"),
140	    // Set while an offer is outstanding
141	    offerToken: text("offer_token"),
142	    // Redis hold reserving the slot for this client while the offer stands
143	    offerHoldToken: text("offer_hold_token"),
144	    offerSlotStartAt: timestamp("offer_slot_start_at", { withTimezone: true }),
145	    offerSlotEndAt: timestamp("offer_slot_end_at", { withTimezone: true }),
146	    offerExpiresAt: timestamp("offer_expires_at", { withTimezone: true }),
147	    offerStaffId: uuid("offer_staff_id").references(() => staff.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
148	    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
149	  },
150	  (t) => [
151	    uniqueIndex("waitlist_offer_token_unique").on(t.offerToken),
152	    index("waitlist_queue_idx").on(t.businessId, t.dateISO, t.status, t.createdAt),
153	  ],
154	);
155	
156	export const outboxStatuses = ["pending", "processing", "sent", "dead", "cancelled"] as const;
157	
158	/**
159	 * Transactional outbox. Rows are written in the same transaction as the
160	 * business change they describe, so a booking and its confirmation can never
161	 * disagree about whether they happened. A worker drains them separately.
162	 */
163	export const outbox = pgTable(
164	  "outbox",
165	  {
166	    id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
167	    businessId: uuid("business_id").notNull().references(() => businesses.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
168	    topic: text("topic").notNull(), // booking.confirmed, booking.reminder, waitlist.offer, …
169	    payload: jsonb("payload").notNull(),
170	    // Natural key of the thing this message is about. Lets callers enqueue
171	    // idempotently and cancel a scheduled message that is no longer wanted.
172	    dedupeKey: text("dedupe_key"),
173	    availableAt: timestamp("available_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
174	    status: text("status", { enum: outboxStatuses }).notNull().default("pending"),
175	    attempts: integer("attempts").notNull().default(0),
176	    maxAttempts: integer("max_attempts").notNull().default(5),
177	    lastError: text("last_error"),
178	    createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
179	    updatedAt: timestamp("updated_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
180	  },
181	  (t) => [
182	    uniqueIndex("outbox_dedupe_key_unique").on(t.dedupeKey),
183	    index("outbox_claim_idx").on(t.status, t.availableAt),
184	  ],
185	);
186	
187	/** Everything a channel actually delivered — the demo's stand-in for an ESP. */
188	export const messageLog = pgTable("message_log", {
189	  id: uuid("id").primaryKey().defaultRandom(),
190	  businessId: uuid("business_id").notNull().references(() => businesses.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
191	  outboxId: uuid("outbox_id").references(() => outbox.id, { onDelete: "set null" }),
192	  channel: text("channel", { enum: ["email", "sms"] }).notNull(),
193	  recipient: text("recipient").notNull(),
194	  subject: text("subject").notNull(),
195	  body: text("body").notNull(),
196	  createdAt: timestamp("created_at", { withTimezone: true }).notNull().defaultNow(),
197	});
198	
199	export const auditLog = pgTable("audit_log", {

201	  businessId: uuid("business_id").notNull().references(() => businesses.id, { onDelete: "cascade" }),
202	  actorUserId: uuid("actor_user_id").references(() => users.id),

content.text:
Overlapping confirmed bookings for the same master are now rejected by Postgres itself, so the race can't happen regardless of which app server handles the checkout. The losing client gets `409 {"error": "slot_taken"}`. Nothing is committed.

**What changed**
- **`drizzle/0004_booking_no_overlap.sql`** (new, registered in the journal with a chained snapshot): enables `btree_gist` and adds an exclusion constraint `bookings_no_overlap_confirmed` on `(staff_id, tstzrange(start_at, end_at))`, restricted to `status = 'confirmed'`. Cancelled, completed, and no-show rows don't block time, and different masters don't conflict.
- **`src/lib/booking.ts`**: the booking transaction is wrapped in a try/catch. If the constraint fires, `createBooking` returns `{ ok: false, error: "slot_taken" }`, which the existing route already maps to 409. The Redis hold check is unchanged.
- **`src/lib/booking.integration.test.ts`**: new test where two overlapping bookings with different start times race, and exactly one wins.

**Verification**
- Unit tests pass, and eslint is clean on the changed files.
- I started throwaway Postgres 16 and Redis 7 containers, ran `pnpm test:integration`, and removed them afterwards. The migration applied cleanly, and the booking, waitlist, and notify suites pass, including the new race test.

**Before deploying**

result:
Overlapping confirmed bookings for the same master are now rejected by Postgres itself, so the race can't happen regardless of which app server handles the checkout. The losing client gets `409 {"error": "slot_taken"}`. Nothing is committed.

**What changed**
- **`drizzle/0004_booking_no_overlap.sql`** (new, registered in the journal with a chained snapshot): enables `btree_gist` and adds an exclusion constraint `bookings_no_overlap_confirmed` on `(staff_id, tstzrange(start_at, end_at))`, restricted to `status = 'confirmed'`. Cancelled, completed, and no-show rows don't block time, and different masters don't conflict.
- **`src/lib/booking.ts`**: the booking transaction is wrapped in a try/catch. If the constraint fires, `createBooking` returns `{ ok: false, error: "slot_taken" }`, which the existing route already maps to 409. The Redis hold check is unchanged.
- **`src/lib/booking.integration.test.ts`**: new test where two overlapping bookings with different start times race, and exactly one wins.
